_about: SYNTHETIC page text for the fictional Example Vendor report (data/sample/sample_soc2_extraction.json). Written for the demo; not copied from any real report. Only the pages the demo cites are filled in.
1: Example Vendor Inc. SOC 2 Type 2 Report on Example Vendor's Ledger Cloud system, relevant to Security and Availability, for the period 1 January 2025 to 30 June 2025. It reports on how the system is described and whether its controls were well designed and worked as intended.
5: Scope. We have examined Example Vendor Inc.'s description of its Ledger Cloud system for the period 1 January 2025 to 30 June 2025, and whether the controls in that description were suitably designed and worked as intended to meet the trust services criteria relevant to Security and Availability (applicable trust services criteria). Example Vendor also makes Confidentiality commitments to its customers; the Confidentiality category was not part of this examination. Subservice organizations. Example Vendor uses Nimbus Cloud (NC) for infrastructure hosting, Gitworks Inc for source code management, and Ledgerly for billing. The description excludes the controls of these subservice organizations (carve-out method), and our examination did not extend to them.
28: Complementary user entity controls. Example Vendor designed its controls on the assumption that each customer: (1) approves and periodically reviews which of its staff have Ledger Cloud accounts; (2) removes accounts promptly when staff leave; (3) enables multi-factor sign-in for its administrators; (4) protects the devices its staff use to reach Ledger Cloud; (5) reviews the activity reports Example Vendor provides; (6) reports suspected security incidents to Example Vendor promptly; (7) keeps its own copies of data it exports; (8) tests its own business continuity arrangements; (9) reviews and accepts changes to its service agreement.
33: Tests of controls and results. 118 controls were tested with the result No exceptions noted. One control had a deviation: for 1 of 25 sampled leavers, the account was removed 9 days after the leaving date, against a target of 2 days. Management's response: the account had no activity after the leaving date; the removal process now runs daily.
